review:
Hamburgini is solid.  If you are looking for fast-food and cheap prices, choose this over any American chain in town.

Burgers
The burgers are good fast-food burgers—not life changing, but decent fast-food.  This fast-food burger is miles ahead of US chains in the area, which always seem to be cold and tough.   The patty was good for fast food and had a coaster grind than I had expected.  The meat was fairly tender.

Sides
Sweet Potato Fires. The sweet potato fries were money!  They were extremely crisp on the outside and nice and soft on the inside.  I wonder if they coat it with something to get them this crisp.  The accompanying lemon sauce was very intriguing and enjoyable—it worked.
Hamburgini Fries. Stay away front he Hamburgini fries.  They were awful and I could not even identify whatever they added in addition to the nacho cheese sauce.
Jalapeño Poppers.  Nothing special here.

review:
I recently stopped by Hamburgini in Al Qusur for a bite, and let me tell you, it was a delightful experience from start to finish.

Walking in, I was greeted by a cozy atmosphere and the smell of delicious burgers sizzling on the grill. After scanning the menu, I went with the classic "Hamburgini Supreme" burger and a side of crispy onion rings.

The burger was amazing—juicy patty, fresh veggies, and just the right amount of sauce on a soft bun. The onion rings were crispy and flavorful, perfect for dunking in their tangy sauce.

To wash it all down, I treated myself to a chocolate milkshake, creamy and satisfying.

What impressed me most was the friendly service. The staff made sure I had everything I needed and made me feel right at home.

Overall, my visit to Hamburgini Al Qusur was a tasty adventure I won't soon forget. If you're in the area and craving a great burger, Hamburgini is the place to go.
